heals.title: LIVREUR PII cleanup — PENDING_CREATE_ scaffold token removed but null+phone bug surfaced
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/foodking-round3-verify/livreur/heal2-delivery-boys.png shows row 'Livreur E2E | livreur.e2e@lecayenne.test | null+33700000010 | Actif'.
PASS — String 'PENDING_CREATE_' is GONE (search returned false in rendered HTML).
FAIL — Phone displays as 'null+33700000010' instead of '+33700000010'.

Root cause: resources/js/components/admin/deliveryBoys/DeliveryBoyListComponent.vue:95-96 renders `deliveryBoy.country_code + '' + deliveryBoy.phone`. DB row for user 10 has country_code=null, phone='+33700000010'. JS coerces null+''→'null', producing 'null+33700000010'.
Fix candidates: either (a) backend seeder should set country_code=null and template should guard `(country_code || '') + phone`, or (b) seeder sets country_code='+33' and phone='700000010'.
